```{r pkgs, message = FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(survival)
library(simsurv)
library(tidyverse); theme_set(theme_bw())
```

```{r seed}
set.seed(427)
```

```{r basic_test1}
lambda <- 0.1
gamma <- 1.5
t <- seq(0, 10, length.out = 200)

h0 <- lambda * gamma * t^(gamma - 1)   
H0 <- lambda * t^gamma           
S0 <- exp(-H0)                      
df <- data.frame(t, h0, H0, S0)

p1 <- ggplot(df, aes(x = t, y = h0)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1.2) +
  labs(title = "Weibull Baseline Hazard Function (h₀(t))",
       x = "Time (t)", y = "Hazard h₀(t)") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14)

p2 <- ggplot(df, aes(x = t, y = H0)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1.2, color = "steelblue") +
  labs(title = "Cumulative Hazard Function (H₀(t))",
       x = "Time (t)", y = "Cumulative hazard H₀(t)") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14)

p3 <- ggplot(df, aes(x = t, y = S0)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1.2, color = "darkred") +
  labs(title = "Survival Function (S₀(t))",
       x = "Time (t)", y = "Survival probability S₀(t)") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14)

p1; p2; p3
```

```{r}
N <- 500
beta <- c(x = log(1.5))
covs <- data.frame(x = rbinom(N, 1, 0.5))

dat <- simsurv(lambdas = 0.1, gammas = 1.5, betas = beta, x = covs, maxt = 5)
dat <- merge(dat, covs)
head(dat)
```

```{r}
fit_cox <- coxph(Surv(eventtime, status) ~ x, data = dat)
fit_weibull <- survreg(Surv(eventtime, status) ~ x, data = dat, dist = "weibull")
```

```{r}
set.seed(123)
nsim <- 1000
results <- data.frame(matrix(NA, nrow = nsim, ncol = 3))
names(results) <- c("theta_hat", "se_hat", "converged")


for (i in 1:nsim) {
  covs <- data.frame(x = rbinom(N, 1, 0.5))
  dat <- simsurv(lambdas = 0.1, gammas = 1.5, betas = beta, x = covs, maxt = 5)
  fit <- try(coxph(Surv(eventtime, status) ~ x, data = dat), silent = TRUE)
  
  if (inherits(fit, "try-error")) {
    results$converged[i] <- FALSE
  } else {
    results$converged[i] <- TRUE
    results$theta_hat[i] <- coef(fit)
    results$se_hat[i] <- sqrt(diag(vcov(fit)))
  }
}

```

```{r}
theta_true <- beta
valid <- subset(results, converged == TRUE)

bias <- mean(valid$theta_hat - theta_true)
empSE <- sd(valid$theta_hat)
MSE <- mean((valid$theta_hat - theta_true)^2)
cover <- mean(abs(valid$theta_hat - theta_true) <= 1.96 * valid$se_hat)
MCSE_bias <- sqrt(var(valid$theta_hat - theta_true) / nrow(valid))
```

```{r}
valid <- subset(results, converged == TRUE)

theta_true <- as.numeric(beta)

ggplot(valid, aes(x = theta_hat)) +
  geom_histogram(aes(y = ..density..), bins = 40, fill = "skyblue", color = "white", alpha = 0.7) +
  geom_density(color = "blue", size = 1) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = theta_true, color = "red", linetype = "dashed", size = 1.2) +
  labs(
    title = "Distribution of Estimated Coefficients (θ̂)",
    x = expression(hat(theta)),
    y = "Density"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14)
```

```{r scatter}
ggplot(valid, aes(x = se_hat, y = theta_hat)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.4, color = "darkblue") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = theta_true, linetype = "dashed", color = "red", size = 1) +
  labs(
    title = "Scatter of Estimates vs. Model SE",
    x = "Model-based SE (√Var(θ̂))",
    y = expression(hat(theta))
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14)

```

```{r mse}
library(dplyr)

perf <- data.frame(
  Metric = c("Bias", "Empirical SE", "MSE", "Coverage"),
  Value = c(bias, empSE, MSE, cover)
)

ggplot(perf, aes(x = Metric, y = Value, fill = Metric)) +
  geom_col(alpha = 0.7) +
  geom_text(aes(label = round(Value, 3)), vjust = -0.5, size = 5) +
  labs(title = "Performance Metrics Summary") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(legend.position = "none")

```

```{r ci}
valid$lower <- valid$theta_hat - 1.96 * valid$se_hat
valid$upper <- valid$theta_hat + 1.96 * valid$se_hat
valid$covered <- (theta_true >= valid$lower & theta_true <= valid$upper)

valid <- valid %>% arrange(abs(theta_hat - theta_true)) %>% mutate(rank = row_number())

ggplot(valid, aes(x = rank, y = theta_hat)) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = lower, ymax = upper, color = covered), width = 0.4) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = theta_true, color = "red", linetype = "dashed") +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("FALSE" = "orange", "TRUE" = "steelblue")) +
  labs(
    title = "Zip Plot of Confidence Interval Coverage",
    x = "Ranked Repetitions",
    y = expression(hat(theta)),
    color = "Covered?"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14)

```

```{r km1}
dat <- simsurv(lambdas = 0.1, gammas = 1.5, betas = beta, x = covs, maxt = 5)
dat <- merge(dat, covs)

fit_km <- survfit(Surv(eventtime, status) ~ x, data = dat)

km_df <- data.frame(
  time = fit_km$time,
  surv = fit_km$surv,
  x = rep(c("x=0", "x=1"), fit_km$strata)
)

t_seq <- seq(0, 5, length.out = 200)
theory_df <- data.frame(
  time = rep(t_seq, 2),
  x = rep(c("x=0", "x=1"), each = length(t_seq)),
  S = c(
    exp(-lambda * t_seq^gamma),                        
    exp(-lambda * exp(beta["x"]) * t_seq^gamma)              
  )
)

ggplot() +

  geom_step(data = km_df, aes(x = time, y = surv, color = x), size = 1, alpha = 0.8) +

  geom_line(data = theory_df, aes(x = time, y = S, color = x), linetype = "dashed", size = 1) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("x=0" = "steelblue", "x=1" = "firebrick")) +
  labs(
    title = "Kaplan–Meier vs Weibull",
    subtitle = "Dashed lines = true model; solid lines = sample KM estimates",
    x = "Time",
    y = "Survival Probability",
    color = "Group"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(legend.position = "top")
```
